q: Do I spread a new machine's carbon footprint over its life or count it all in the year I buy it?
title: Capital goods: count in purchase year
short: Count it all in the year of purchase. The GHG Protocol Scope 3 Standard puts capital goods in category 2 and does not depreciate them, so a big purchase makes that year's Scope 3 jump. Explain the spike in the report rather than smoothing it.
audience: MSMEs buying machines, vehicles, buildings or IT equipment

ul: Supplier footprint for the machine if available.
Otherwise spend times a factor for the equipment type.
Report category 2 separately from category 1 purchases.

p: Year-on-year comparisons can mislead. Note the purchase and show results with and without it.

senseible: Senseible turns supplier invoices into a Scope 3 record with the supplier, quantity and factor behind every figure, so you can see which data is still missing.
